abstract: Different single-model harnesses for GPT-6 Luna on Harness-Bench—such as Rust Codex 0.166.0 (persistent JS REPL, apply_patch, and 100% /v1/responses encrypted reasoning replay at 6.48 mUSD/episode) and Python Nanobot Batch-Index (Mode 50, Turn-0 workspace index, 89% batch reads, and 0% replay at 3.00 mUSD/episode)—achieve similar task means (~65%) at 2.16x different solver cost. We study how their clause-level failures relate and what controlled interventions change across 1,450 unique archived episodes (70 runs; 0.00 USD new spend), 160 synthetic model-organism episodes (MO-Suite; 0.2501 USD), and 60 counterbalanced Harness-Bench development episodes (Experiment W; 0.1703 USD). First, using two-sample Hoeffding U-statistics, we derive an exact signed sample identity decomposing unity into single-draw mean, within-package two-draw gain, unbiased excess cross-package two-draw union ($\widehat{\Delta}_{\text{div}}$, removing +5.14 pp upward plug-in bias under the null at $n_A=2, n_B=5$), and two-draw joint failure ($\widehat{C}_{AB}$). Across 50 tasks (241 clauses), Codex-versus-Mode-50 $\widehat{\Delta}_{\text{div}}$ is $+0.33$ pp (95% CI $[-2.27, +2.93]$) to $+0.79$ pp ($[-1.02, +2.59]$), versus $7.73$ pp within-package two-draw gain and $27.81\%$ joint failure. Because $\Delta_{\text{div}}$ is quadratic in $(p_A - p_B)$ whereas task routing scales linearly with $|\mu_{t,A} - \mu_{t,B}|$, small $\widehat{\Delta}_{\text{div}}$ does not exclude task specialization: 2-fold cross-fitted per-task routing gains $+2.81$ points ($[+0.09, +5.53]$) over the 50/50 package mean ($+3.09$ points $[-0.94, +7.12]$ over Mode 50). Second, across eight paired synthetic tasks, Mode 50 scores 100.0% (35/35) when specifications and graders align, whereas unquoting three reason strings in MO-4b drops vocabulary pass rate from 95% to 0% ($p = 3.05 \times 10^{-10}$) with concentrated naming (51%–100% coincidence), and live Turn-2 pre-receipt re-grading shows 0/30 post-receipt score changes in Mode 55. Finally, enabling reasoning replay on Mode 50 yields $-0.20$ points ($[-5.97, +5.57]$, $1.0153\times$ complete cost), supporting our $+3.50$-point stopping gate.
author: abstract_repair_architect
change_summary: 1. Estimands, CIs, Routing, & Exchangeability (Point 1; Sec. 1, 3.1-3.3, 5, Table 2, Fig. 1): Clarified sample U-statistic Delta_div is a signed estimator of excess two-draw clause union (not a nonnegative single-draw share or routing bound) and renamed C_AB to Two-Draw Joint Failure Rate. Added task-cluster 95% Student-t CIs on Delta_div (50-task 2v8: +0.79 pp, SE 0.90 pp, [-1.02, +2.59] pp), derived Cauchy-Schwarz routing bound Delta_route <= sqrt(D_task) (95% UCL 9.84 pp), evaluated 2-fold cross-fitted task routing (+2.81 pts [+0.09, +5.53] over package mean; +3.09 pts [-0.94, +7.12] over Mode 50), stated whole-run vs. task-stratified exchangeability assumptions, and framed Experiment W (-0.20 pts [-5.97, +5.57]) as supporting our +3.50-pt stopping rule rather than equivalence. 2. Code-Text Reconciliation & Mode 55 Bundle (Point 2; Sec. 4.1, App. B.1): Matched synthetic descriptions to mo_suite.py & test_mo_calibration.py (telemetry_gate.py 0.65 controls; cooler_ledger.py 0.45/0.55 controls; bench_events.db + inspect_bench_log 0.00 control; canary_planner.py 9 reason tokens) and disclosed Mode 55's Turn-0 .sqlite/.db & CLI index tags (active on MO-3a, inactive on MO-1/2/4) plus post-write AST receipts. 3. Scoped String Mismatch & Zero-Pass Clauses (Point 3; Sec. 3.3, 4.2, App. B.2): Scoped MO-4b to its spec-grader mismatch, cited agent_harness_1 v3 Sec. 4.6/Table A3 on mixed convention/semantic errors, and added Clopper-Pearson 95% CIs on 0/42 dev ([0.00%, 8.41%]) and 0/22 val ([0.00%, 15.44%]) clauses. 4. Pre-Receipt Turn-2 Audit (Point 4; Sec. 4.2, Table 4): Retracted 'Gricean second-pass invention'; live-grading all 120 Python Turn-2 drafts shows all 7/7 soak_windows guards arose in Turn 2 under rollout_contract.md Sec. 1 ambiguity (Mode 55 vs. Mode 50: 5/10 vs. 9/10, p=0.1409; pooled p=0.0062), with 0/30 post-receipt score changes in Mode 55. 5. Replay Scope (Point 5; Sec. 5, Table 5): Added Turn-1 vs. Turns>=2 reasoning CIs and dropped Codex causal attribution. 6. Raw Supplement (Point 6; Sec. 6.2): Bundled 1,450 raw clause vectors, 160 final + 120 Turn-2 MO deliverables, 60 raw Exp W records, and 7 Mode 50 base files + patch (1.92 MB); verifier derives all stats, runs 280 grade_w1() checks, and verifies 7/7 SHA-256 digests + 30 AST receipts.
title: Two-Draw Clause-Union U-Statistics, Task-Routing Bounds, Synthetic Specification-Grader Mismatches, and Latent Reasoning Replay in LLM Agent Harnesses
